author: Bobby Grayson
title: Piece (3) needed no translator change: reason_str already maps :normal to .normal and :kill to .kill for Process.exit/2, {:stop, r, s} and exit/1 alike (process_exit.ex covers .signal p .normal and .signal p .kill; stop_kill.ex covers .exit .kill). Added only a GenServer handle_info(:bye, n), do: exit(:kill) clause to stop_kill.ex (renders .exit .kill) so the self-kill from a callback, not just from a raw loop, is pinned by a fixture.
